title: Where my game is after about a day
author: PactFresh
selftext: Very inspired by sacred stones. Unity ai basically tripped over itself to build me the grid and basic models. After that I switch to Codex and have been absolutely amazed. Amazing usage limits (on20$ plan) foreseen almost every issue and dealt with it before I asked. Perceptive recommendations. And this is where I sit after about a day. Main thing I’m worried about going forward is art and animation (same with other projects I’m working on) but with how easy it has made this I can actually see finishing it.
